title: CYBRIK capability registry entry v1
description: A signed, digest-pinned capability descriptor in the Tool Fabric capability registry (strategy 05 §5.1; ADR-0004). Registration MUST be rejected if digest, signature, license, owner, risk_class, side_effects, schemas, or limits are missing (fail-closed). MCP is an adapter over these capabilities, not a trust boundary (ADR-0006). Status: ACCEPTED FOR IMPLEMENTATION (v0.1.0; not stable v1/GA).

name.description: Capability name, dotted vendor-neutral form, e.g. 'soc.search_related_events'. Combined with version and digest for pinned invocation.

digest.description: Digest of the capability package. Invocations pin this digest; a digest mismatch MUST be denied.

signature_ref.description: Reference to the detached signature/attestation over `digest` (e.g. a sigstore bundle reference). The signature material itself is not inlined.

side_effects.description: Effect class. A patch release MUST NOT change side_effects, risk_class, or input semantics — that is a major change (ADR-0001; strategy 05 §9).

isolation_profile.description: Minimum isolation floor. Policy may raise isolation but never lower it (ADR-0004 F3). S0 permitted only for R0.

network_policy.description: Declared egress posture; enforced by the broker (ADR-0004 F5).

input_schema_ref.description: Reference ($id or relative path) to the JSON Schema for invocation arguments.

output_schema_ref.description: Reference ($id or relative path) to the JSON Schema for invocation result output.

required_scopes.description: Authorization scopes the caller must hold. Empty array = no capability grantable (fail-closed), not 'public'.

limits.description: Mandatory execution bounds (ADR-0004 F7): every invocation is time/CPU/RAM/output/egress bounded.

integrity_receipt.description: Whether a signed execution receipt is required for this capability's output to be admissible.
